thread:
Nina Patel: Weekly account health check for Marlin Capital. Quick focus: p95/p99 by route+model and streaming vs sync. Noticed sharp tail on streaming /chat-stream (rwd-llama-8b-quant). Sharing top-line and suggested next steps.

Nina Patel: 7d rolling summary: 
- /chat-stream  | model=rwd-llama-8b-quant | streaming   | p95=380ms | p99=2.4s  (7d delta: +120% p99)
- /chat-sync    | model=rwd-llama-8b-quant | non-stream  | p95=310ms | p99=650ms
- /summarize    | model=open-llama-3b       | streaming   | p95=130ms | p99=470ms
- /embed        | model=rwd-embed-3        | non-stream  | p95=50ms  | p99=110ms
Errors: /chat-stream 5xx rose from 0.2% -> 0.9% (retries increased).
Spend: billable tokens +22% week-over-week (more retries and long tails).

Harold Kim: Noted. Any recent client-side changes?

Nina Patel: Marlin rolled a client patch two days ago toggling chunking=v2 (smaller chunks). Also they migrated traffic through a new edge region last night.

Harold Kim: Looking at telemetry  preliminary: KV cache hit for Marlin dropped 80% -> 42% after the patch. Batching distribution skewed toward tiny batches (batch size mode =1).

Harold Kim: Helpful probe: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://telemetry.internal/api/accounts/marlin/metrics?metric=batching_histogram&range=7d" | jq .hist
```

Sami Ortega: Infra side saw repeated GC pauses on node worker-3 around the same windows. Log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-10T11:04:22Z] worker-3 GC pause 145ms, mem-pressure 81%
[2026-03-10T11:04:23Z] worker-3 eviction: prefix-cache cleared for account marlin
[2026-03-10T11:04:23Z] worker-3 tail-latency spike 2.1s
```
Seems correlated with cache churn + smaller streaming chunks.

Leah Brooks: For renewal scoring: our practice is to flag as "elevated-risk" if p99 >2s for 48+ hours or if spend increases >20% w/o clear plan. Currently p99 >2s but duration <48h. I'll keep monitoring.

Nina Patel: Proposed mitigations: 1) ask Marlin to revert chunking=v2 temporarily; 2) enable prefix caching on /chat-stream for them; 3) tweak server-side batching window to favor slightly larger groups for streaming; 4) offer a short Dedicated burst for peak hours if they accept.

Sami Ortega: I can run a quick A/B: enable prefix cache for 1 hour on a small subset and measure p99 delta. Historically we saw ~30% p99 improvement for similar patterns.

Harold Kim: I'll collect top request IDs and traces (mc-req-e7, mc-req-e8, mc-req-e9) and attach to the CS ticket. Also will run KV hit-rate per worker: 
```
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/kv/hits?account=marlin&range=24h" | jq .by_worker
```

ops-bot: Automated anomaly report: "Marlin Capital - streaming route p99 deviation (7d vs 30d) = +112% (anomaly_score=0.79)" Link: https://ops.internal/anom/marlin/1746002468

Nina Patel: Action items: 
- Harold: upload traces + KV per-worker breakdown to ticket (T+3h).
- Sami: run controlled prefix-cache A/B and post results (T+6h).
- Leah: prepare renewal risk note; escalate to AE if criteria met (T+24h).
- CS: schedule enablement call with Marlin to walk rollback and discuss Dedicated burst (T+36h).

Leah Brooks: I'll draft the AE note and include spend delta context. If A/B shows improvement we'll delay escalation.

Harold Kim: Attaching initial trace bundle to ticket now. Will follow up with per-worker GC timeline.

Nina Patel: Thanks team. I'll update the account health doc and mark this as high-priority until we see p99 <1.2s for 24h. cc @Leah Brooks @Sami Ortega :rocket:
